decision.rationale: The candidate passed every fixed synthetic development gate and corrected the any-hit failure, but the unblinded source-alias-assisted data cannot support method selection or a real-world quality claim.
limitations: The labels are deterministic development labels, not independently validated gold.
Source aliases and questions originate from the same synthetic design.
The clean paired draft did not measure naturally occurring post-generation claim failures.
The all-pass percentile bootstrap is degenerate and does not establish zero population risk.
No provider, private source, held-out, multimodal product, T1 promotion, or professor-fidelity evaluation occurred.
